subject: HarborEdge — pause demo while they reassign sprint resources
messages:
From: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harboredge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HarborEdge Product Team <product@harboredge.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo slot next week (Aug 31) — ask to pause

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Apologies for the short notice. We had a product sync this morning and leadership has pulled a couple of engineers onto an urgent data-pipeline migration that overlaps with the next two sprints. As a result, the team needs to deprioritize new feature pilots that require dedicated infra changes — including the inference/LLM pilot we discussed.

Can we please pause the demo we had on the calendar for Aug 31? The reasons are twofold: 1) the key engineers who would run the POC are now assigned to the migration, and 2) several folks who travel to the site next week will be out of the office the week after.

Wed like to stay on a waitlist or get a recording/POC checklist in the meantime — so when we re-open the work in Q4 we can pick up faster. If you have a short checklist for a self-serve evaluation or a 15-20 minute recorded walkthrough, thatd be helpful.

Thanks for understanding. Ill loop back when leadership gives a firmer timeline; right now the ask is to put the demo on hold while we reassign resources.

Best,
Ethan Walker
Director of Product, HarborEdge
ethan.walker@harboredge.com
+1 617-555-0189

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (requested hold)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harboredge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo slot next week (Aug 31) — ask to pause

Hi Ethan,

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up and for being candid about the resource shift. No problem putting the Aug 31 session on hold. Well mark the slot as tentative and move the meeting to a waitlist state.

In the meantime, Ill send over a 20-min recorded demo and a one-page POC checklist that outlines the minimal infra and data items your eng team would need to spin up a quick eval. If helpful, we can also provide an example Docker/terraform snippet to make the first-stage setup faster once youre ready.

Two quick questions so we can tailor the materials:
- Do you want the demo to be focused on throughput/cost controls or on model-quality/regression monitoring?
- Is it okay if we include a short SOW draft (no prices) describing a scoped pilot so your procurement folks have something to review when the timeline opens?

Ill drop the materials to the Drive link and send a recording by EOD tomorrow. Marissa / Priyom: can you please update the HubSpot stage to "On Hold" and flag this as Q4 follow-up? Ive attached a calendar stub to free the slot for others.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-4472

Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo slot next week (Aug 31) — ask to pause

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick reply and for the flexibility. Yes, a short recording plus the POC checklist would be perfect — wed like the version that emphasizes the minimal infra and the recommended quantization/latency knobs (throughput/cost controls would be the priority for us).

Including a non-binding SOW draft is fine; procurement likes to see a basic scope so they can calendar time later. Well accept materials and be on the waitlist. Ill re-open timing with leadership and get back to you in late Sept with a Q4 window.

Appreciate the assist — please mark the demo as on hold and remove the hard invite.

Best,
Ethan

Attachment: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: HarborEdge — move to On Hold in CRM and Q4 follow-up plan

Marissa / Priyom,

Quick internal note on HarborEdge / DEAL-9817: prospect asked to pause the Aug 31 demo due to sprint reallocation and travel; they want recording + POC checklist and to be put on a waitlist. Likelihood of active POC this quarter: low.

Please do the following:
- Update HubSpot stage to "On Hold" and set next contact task for 2026-10-04 (owner: Marissa).
- Attach the non-binding SOW draft to the record (SOW-draft-v1.pdf).
- Remove the hard calendar invite and keep the slot free (calendar-invite.ics attached as stub).
- Flag as revenue risk in the weekly forecast and note reason: "engineering resource reallocation / product priority shift."

If they come back earlier, send the short demo recording + checklist; if not, we should requalify in Oct and propose a small discovery session to confirm scope before rebooking demos.

Thanks — Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
